label: Story coverage
formula: Stories linked to at least one reusable Test Case ÷ exact scoped Stories × 100. An unknown or partial denominator remains unknown.
criteria: Treat a Story as covered only when a current project-scoped work-item relationship points to a reusable Test Case. Do not infer coverage from labels, title similarity, or locally loaded rows.

label: Design completeness
formula: Cases with at least one persisted Test Step ÷ exact project-scoped Test Cases × 100. The quality overview exposes the raw counts; unavailable sources remain null.
criteria: A persisted Test Step makes structured design observable; this does not assess action/result quality, Gherkin semantics, execution or automation. Use complete scoped counts and disclose unavailable case or step evidence.

label: Pass rate
formula: Passed finalized outcomes ÷ (passed + failed + blocked finalized outcomes) × 100. Running, queued, skipped, and unknown outcomes are excluded.
criteria: Use the latest immutable finalized outcome for each item in scope. Never convert an absent denominator into 0% or 100%.

label: Execution completion
formula: Finalized case outcomes ÷ total cases in the exact run or module scope × 100.
criteria: Passed, failed, and blocked are finalized. Queued, not run, and running are incomplete. Preserve unknown scope instead of estimating from loaded rows.

label: Run confidence
formula: A deterministic composite of scoped execution completion, finalized pass evidence, recency, and unresolved failure or blocker penalties; unavailable inputs remain disclosed.
criteria: Prefer recent release-scoped evidence. Penalize failed or blocked outcomes and stale or missing evidence; do not let an AI narrative change the deterministic score.
runtime_note: Historical methodology without an active calculator in this revision. Use current dashboard or release measurements. Existing settings are retained for reference.

label: Automation coverage
surface: Test Cases, projects, and automation analytics
formula: Cases explicitly marked automated ÷ all exact project-scoped Test Cases × 100. Source unavailability remains null; execution readiness is a separate measurement.
criteria: Disclose that this measures the recorded automation classification, not a successful run or verified executable behavior. Do not infer automation from generated code text. Current native dashboard automation coverage also accepts automation_status ready and is documented separately.

label: Defect density
formula: Distinct linked Defects in the exact Story or Test Case scope ÷ exact scoped Stories or Test Cases. Report the unit and state filter; open-Defect counts are separate measurements.
criteria: Use current project-scoped relationships and deduplicate each Defect across multiple links. Disclose numerator, denominator, entity unit and any explicit open-state filter. Do not silently compare density per Story, per Test Case and per ten Test Cases as the same unit.

label: Story design completeness
formula: Average of four authored-contract completeness dimensions: scope = title × 35 + description × 65; intent = title × 20 + description × 40 + acceptance completeness × 40; design = title × 15 + description × 25 + acceptance completeness × 60; acceptance = non-placeholder acceptance-item ratio × 100. Presence signals are zero or one. No NFR, linkage, label, delivery or benchmark bonus applies.
criteria: Explain authored scope and acceptance completeness against the stated Story objective. Scores are structural completeness signals, not semantic correctness, standards alignment, user value, certification, market research or release approval. NFR categories, negative paths, external research, linked tests, labels and delivery metadata do not change the design score. Review product meaning and missing evidence separately; never invent requirements, quality thresholds or standards applicability.

label: Test design completeness
formula: Average of four authored-design measurements: scenario = title × 20 + description × 30 + steps-present × 20 + complete action/result ratio × 30; clarity = non-placeholder pair ratio × 75 + non-generic assertion ratio × 25; local data = resolved referenced-local-input ratio × 100 (100 when no local input is needed, zero with no steps); self-contained design = title × 30 + description × 30 + complete pair ratio × 40. Execution outcomes, approval, automation, negative categories and optional links do not change this score.
criteria: Explain authored objective, action/result completeness and supplied local data references for the stated case scope. Scores do not establish semantic correctness, observed reliability, approval or a probability. Focused positive/manual and standalone cases need no unrelated negative/NFR scenario, Story link, automation, suite, external source, approval or run history to achieve full structural completeness. Recorded execution is disclosed separately as observed or unavailable and never folded into the authored-design score.

label: Smart Run priority
formula: Deterministic ranking from failed or blocked recency, linked Defect and Story risk, delivery-scope match, and available Test Case evidence.
criteria: Prioritize direct release or Sprint scope and recent failures. AI may explain the ranking but cannot add cases unsupported by the bounded candidate set.

label: Project portfolio health
formula: Arithmetic mean of each accessible project's readiness score. Readiness combines exact Story coverage, automation coverage, and quality pass rate using the configured weights. Quality pass rate is passed finalized Test Cases plus resolved Defects divided by finalized Test Cases plus all Defects.
criteria: Treat every accessible project equally rather than weighting by record volume. Keep projects without assessable scope identified as new and disclose missing evidence.

parameters.label: Story coverage weight
parameters.help: Contribution of exact Story-to-Test-Case traceability to project readiness.

parameters.label: Automation coverage weight
parameters.help: Contribution of explicitly automated Test Cases to project readiness.

parameters.label: Pass rate weight
parameters.help: Contribution of finalized Test Case outcomes and resolved Defect outcomes to project readiness.

label: Risky project classification
formula: Count of assessable accessible projects whose newest run has a failed or blocked result, or whose combined Test Case and Defect pass rate is below the configured threshold.
criteria: Use the latest recorded project run for hard failure signals and keep projects without Stories or Test Cases classified as new, not risky.

parameters.label: Risk pass threshold
parameters.help: Projects below this combined Test Case and Defect pass-rate value are classified as risky.

label: Release-ready projects
formula: Count of assessable accessible projects at or above the configured readiness threshold with no hard risk, evidence-policy, or open-Defect attention signal.
criteria: This threshold classifies portfolio attention; it does not approve a release. Keep projects with hard risk or missing-evidence signals out even when their weighted score exceeds the threshold.

parameters.label: Release-ready threshold
parameters.help: Minimum weighted readiness required for the portfolio release-ready classification.

label: Average project Story coverage
formula: Arithmetic mean across visible projects of each project's linked Stories ÷ scoped Stories × 100. Each project has equal weight; projects with no Stories contribute 0%.
criteria: Use direct project-scoped Story–Test Case relationships. Disclose both the unweighted project average and the aggregate linked/scoped counts to prevent denominator confusion.

label: Average project automation coverage
formula: Arithmetic mean across visible projects of Test Cases explicitly marked automated ÷ loaded project Test Cases × 100. Each project has equal weight; projects with no cases contribute 0%.
criteria: Show only when automation analytics permission and feature availability are present. A text snippet or hidden source field does not prove automation.

label: Execution evidence completeness
formula: Latest-run finalized Test Case outcomes with a screenshot, video, or comment at result or run level ÷ latest-run finalized outcomes × 100.
criteria: Flag an assessable project when no finalized run evidence exists or evidence completeness falls below the configured threshold. Do not count unrelated project attachments.

parameters.label: Minimum evidence coverage
parameters.help: Minimum share of latest finalized outcomes that must have screenshot, video, or comment evidence. Set 0 to disable the violation.

label: Projects needing attention
formula: Distinct accessible projects classified as risky or watch after readiness, execution, evidence, and open-Defect policy checks.
criteria: Rank hard execution risk first, then evidence and Defect policy violations, then lowest readiness. Show only the configured number of priority projects on compact card backs.

parameters.label: Priority projects shown
parameters.help: Maximum project names shown on compact attention evidence; the remaining count is summarized.

label: Execution failure cases
formula: Failed Test Case outcomes in each accessible project's newest recorded execution. Blocked outcomes are disclosed separately and are not counted as failures.
criteria: Rank impacted Modules and Stories by distinct failed Test Cases, show only the configured priority items, and summarize the remaining impacted scope.

parameters.label: Priority impacts shown
parameters.help: Maximum highest-impact Modules and Stories returned for compact evidence.

label: Portfolio Defects
formula: Distinct Defects assigned to accessible projects. Open Defects are determined from current workflow status and drive the configurable attention threshold.
criteria: Deduplicate Defects linked through multiple Test Cases or Stories. Rank impacted Modules and Stories by distinct Defects and summarize lower-priority scope.

parameters.label: Open-Defect attention threshold
parameters.help: An assessable project at or above this number of open Defects receives a watch signal. Set 0 to disable this signal.

parameters.label: Priority impacts shown
parameters.help: Maximum highest-impact Modules and Stories returned for compact evidence.

label: Analytics release posture
formula: Story coverage × 35% + design completeness × 25% + latest pass confidence × 40%, minus up to 18 points for latest failed or blocked results and failed runs.
criteria: Use only the bounded active-project evidence shown on the dashboard. Automation adoption never raises this score; incomplete scope must remain visibly provisional.
runtime_note: Historical methodology without an active calculator in this revision. Use current dashboard or release measurements. Existing settings are retained for reference.

label: Analytics latest pass confidence
formula: Passed latest results ÷ all latest visible results in the newest run when available, otherwise passed latest results ÷ all latest visible project results × 100. Running, failed, and blocked evidence remains non-passing.
criteria: Use one latest result per run and Test Case so reruns do not inflate the signal. This live confidence input is intentionally stricter than finalized-only pass rate and remains provisional for bounded scope.
runtime_note: Historical methodology without an active calculator in this revision. Use current dashboard or release measurements. Existing settings are retained for reference.

label: Scope lane readiness
formula: Cases with persisted steps in the product surface ÷ scoped cases × 40%, plus passed latest results ÷ all latest results in that surface × 60%.
criteria: Keep each app-type lane project-scoped. Failed, blocked, and running latest results do not count as passes; an absent case or result denominator contributes zero and stays evident in the lane facts.
runtime_note: Historical methodology without an active calculator in this revision. Use current dashboard or release measurements. Existing settings are retained for reference.

label: Open quality risks
formula: Uncovered Stories + cases without persisted steps + failed latest results + blocked latest results + failed runs.
criteria: This is an action-signal total, not a deduplicated Defect count. Preserve each category so one unstable artifact is not misrepresented as one unique risk.
runtime_note: Historical methodology without an active calculator in this revision. Use current dashboard or release measurements. Existing settings are retained for reference.

label: Release readiness
formula: Story coverage × 25% + execution completion × 20% + latest-terminal-result pass rate × 35% + defect containment × 20%, followed by disclosed caps for missing, stale, partial, blocked, critical-defect, or priority-gap evidence.
criteria: Use only the selected Fix Version and Sprint evidence. A score cannot be definitive when scope, permissions, or source data are incomplete, and a person owns the release decision.

label: Release evidence confidence
formula: When scoped Defects exist: Story coverage × 40% + execution completion × 40% + defect traceability × 20%. With no scoped Defects: coverage × 50% + completion × 50%. Incomplete evidence caps confidence at 69%.
criteria: Confidence measures evidence completeness and linkage, not release safety or model certainty. Missing permissions, bounded sources, and unknown denominators must lower or withhold confidence.

label: Blocking signals
formula: Open critical Defects + latest blocked Test Case outcomes + uncovered P1/P2 Stories in the exact release scope.
criteria: Show the three components independently in evidence. This is an action total across signal types, not a count of unique work items.

label: Story release risk
formula: Priority baseline (P1 25, P2 15, other 5) + 35 if uncovered + 18 if linked but unexecuted + up to 35 each for failed or blocked latest outcomes + up to 40 for critical Defects + up to 20 for other open Defects; capped at 100.
criteria: Rank only project- and release-scoped Stories using direct traceability and latest case evidence. The score orders review work; it does not predict failure probability.

label: Dashboard release confidence
formula: Story coverage × 25% + execution completion × 20% + latest-result pass rate × 35% + defect containment × 20%, rounded to a whole percentage and subject to the lowest applicable cap.
criteria: Use the selected project and optional release scope. Component percentages are rounded first. Defect containment is closed/resolved/done/accepted Defects ÷ all scoped Defects × 100, or 100% with no Defects. Cap at 49% when Stories, Test Cases, or passed/failed/blocked latest results are absent; 69% for any uncovered P1/P2 Story; 59% for any latest blocked result; and 39% for any open Defect whose severity (or priority when severity is absent) is critical/highest. This advisory score does not approve a release.

label: Dashboard case pass rate
formula: Passed latest case results ÷ (passed + failed + blocked latest case results) × 100, rounded to a whole percentage. An empty denominator returns 0%.
criteria: Use only the newest result per Test Case in the selected project and optional release scope, ordered by result creation time and ID. A newer running or pending result replaces an older finalized result. Skipped/N/A, aborted, cancelled, running, pending, and absent results are excluded from the pass-rate denominator.

label: Dashboard execution completion
formula: Distinct Test Cases whose latest result is passed, failed, blocked, skipped, aborted, or cancelled ÷ distinct Test Cases present in run snapshots or latest results × 100, rounded to a whole percentage. An empty denominator returns 0%.
criteria: Use the selected project and optional release scope and the newest result per Test Case. Skipped (shown as N/A), aborted, and cancelled count as complete. Planned cases without a result and cases whose latest result is running or pending remain incomplete; a previous finalized attempt does not replace the latest result.

label: Dashboard evidence confidence
formula: Story coverage × 40% + execution completion × 40% + defect traceability × 20%, rounded to a whole percentage.
criteria: Use the selected project and optional release scope. Defect traceability is scoped Defects with a linked run, Test Case, or Story ÷ all scoped Defects × 100. With no Defects, traceability is 100% and contributes 20 points. Empty Story or planned-case denominators contribute 0%; component percentages are rounded first. This formula has no freshness or partial-evidence caps and measures coverage and linkage, not model certainty or release approval.

label: Execution cycle time
formula: Mean of max(0, ended_at − started_at) in hours across scoped runs with both valid timestamps, rounded to one decimal place. No qualifying runs returns 0 hours.
criteria: Use all runs in the selected project and optional release scope that have valid start and end timestamps, regardless of current status. Missing or invalid timestamps are excluded; negative intervals contribute zero. There is no created_at fallback or 30-day duration cap. This elapsed time includes pauses and does not measure active work or queue time.

label: work-item resolution rate
aliases: percent resolved in the inspected set
formula: work items with a non-empty resolution ÷ all project-scoped JQL items in the inspected set × 100.
criteria: Use the exact validated JQL scope and disclose truncation. A resolution value indicates workflow closure, not necessarily defect correctness.
runtime_note: Historical Jira methodology. The current native evaluator does not calculate this external metric. Retained for reference and existing saved configurations.

label: Average work item age
formula: Mean of current time − created time in whole days across inspected work items with a valid creation timestamp.
criteria: Exclude missing or invalid timestamps and disclose the inspected JQL sample. Do not combine unresolved age with resolution duration.
runtime_note: Historical Jira methodology. The current native evaluator does not calculate this external metric. Retained for reference and existing saved configurations.

label: Average work-item resolution time
formula: Mean of resolution time − creation time in whole days across inspected work items with valid, non-negative timestamps.
criteria: Exclude unresolved items and invalid or negative durations. Disclose the inspected JQL sample and avoid treating the mean as a service-level percentile.
runtime_note: Historical Jira methodology. The current native evaluator does not calculate this external metric. Retained for reference and existing saved configurations.

label: Step completeness
formula: Steps with both a non-blank action and a non-blank observable expected result ÷ authored steps in the selected Test Case × 100.
criteria: Whitespace and formatting alone do not count. Automation code is neither required nor a substitute for a clear manual action and expected result.

label: AI input readiness
formula: 15 points for a specific title + 25 for sufficient description + 25 for linked coverage + 10 for source references + 10 for labels + 15 for Sprint, iteration, Fix Version, or release context.
criteria: Treat this as a local metadata-completeness signal for retrieval and review, not an eligibility gate or model confidence. The actual Story title, description and acceptance behavior can ground a useful request without existing Test Cases, external references, labels, a Sprint or a release. Ask for only the missing evidence necessary for the requested change.

label: Authoring completeness
surface: Test Case authoring and AI Assurance
formula: A deterministic 8-point baseline plus bounded points for title specificity (16), description (20), Story trace (12), labels (10), meaningful steps (22), complete action/expected pairs (14), parameters (8), and permitted automation evidence (8); capped at 100.
criteria: Prioritize observable test intent, traceability, and complete action/expected-result pairs. Automation evidence is optional and must be omitted when the viewer lacks access.

label: Evidence completeness
formula: Scoped cases with any result evidence ÷ total scoped cases × 65 points, plus 20 when Story traceability exists and 15 when Defect or external failure references exist.
criteria: A touched case is not necessarily a passing case. Keep failed and blocked outcomes visible and require human triage before any release conclusion.

label: Locator stability
formula: The saved, deterministic locator stability score, displayed with independent fallback-locator, DOM/accessibility, visual-evidence, and validation-history checks.
criteria: Treat any AI locator as a proposal until the saved score and supporting evidence are human-reviewed and validated against a real screen.

label: AI evidence grounding
formula: No model-confidence percentage is calculated. Inspect exact field-level evidence references, unsupported or missing fields, bounded-source omissions and deterministic fallback fields in the Defect draft.
criteria: Assess the evidence attached to each proposed Defect field and disclose missing or truncated sources. A valid JSON response, model invocation, deterministic fallback or compatibility confidence field does not establish factual correctness, reproduced behavior or model certainty. Do not turn an unscored draft into an invented percentage.

label: Story draft grounding
surface: Create Story with AI draft queue
formula: Candidate completeness: 20 points for a nonempty title + 25 for a description with at least 24 plain-text characters + 35 when acceptance criteria are present + 20 when evidence references are present, minus 10 per unsupported field up to a 40-point penalty; floored at zero. Grounding and testability are separate categorical signals.
criteria: Interpret this as a deterministic field-completeness heuristic, not model confidence or verified behavior. Grounding requires supported evidence references; identify unsupported fields. Do not reward a draft by its list position, infer factual correctness from a numeric score or invent acceptance behavior to improve it.

label: Story Readiness
formula: Current checks marked met ÷ five required checks × 100; no verified checks yields an unknown score. Unverified checks remain in the denominator.
criteria: Use only saved Story evidence and current, attributable reviews bound to the Story content hash. Disclose met, not met and unverified counts. Wireframe reviews require an attachment still on this Story; dependencies and team estimation require review. This checklist is advisory and cannot authorize release approval.

label: Story Release Readiness
formula: Current checks marked met ÷ five required checks × 100; no verified checks yields an unknown score. Unverified checks remain in the denominator.
criteria: Use only saved Story evidence and current, attributable reviews bound to the Story content hash. Disclose met, not met and unverified counts. Acceptance-test review requires complete latest finalized passing linked-case evidence; critical-defect state uses current linked project Defects. Code review, CI and Product Owner sign-off require attributable review. This checklist is advisory and cannot authorize release approval.

label: Story grooming checklist
formula: (Checks marked met + 0.5 × checks marked partial) ÷ all returned readiness checks. The API exposes the ratio in the compatibility confidence field; it is not model certainty.
criteria: Explain the evidence for each met, partial or unmet readiness check. Preserve unknown or missing evidence and do not treat a checklist ratio as approval, calibrated probability or factual verification.

label: Defect triage evidence coverage
formula: Completed required evidence fields across selected Defects ÷ all required evidence fields across those Defects. An empty denominator yields zero. Category refinements do not change deterministic priority or readiness.
criteria: Disclose missing reproduction, observed/expected behavior and impact evidence per Defect. The coverage ratio measures recorded field presence, not accuracy, severity probability or model certainty. Keep category explanation, deterministic priority and write approval separate.

label: Story change-impact heuristic
formula: P1/P2 priority contributes 35 points, other priority 15; linked cases add 8 each up to 32, linked runs add 6 each up to 24, and any automation asset adds 9. Total is capped at 100; high starts at 65 and medium at 30.
criteria: This heuristic summarizes linked review scope, not observed change correctness, failure probability or business impact. Describe the exact proposed delta and supported affected relationships; do not claim linked cases or automation executed.

label: Test Case change-impact signals
formula: Review risk is high with at least three deterministic change signals, medium with one or two, and low with none. Linked asset and result counts disclose potential review scope only.
criteria: Compare saved and proposed case fields and distinguish deterministic relationship changes from model interpretation. Signal count is not defect severity or predicted failure probability. Preserve the actual case objective and do not add unrelated coverage requirements.

label: Verified acceptance coverage
formula: Equal-weight Story acceptance obligations form the denominator. Designed coverage requires a current human-approved assertion mapping; executable and observed coverage require the identical assertion/specification on the selected build and environment. Unknown and stale obligations stay in the denominator; incomplete or empty denominators return unknown.
criteria: Keep linked, designed, executable and observed coverage distinct. A Test Case link or authored automation is not proof an obligation was verified. Do not erase recorded assertion failures with passing retries, infer an unseen denominator or change human mapping decisions.

label: Comparable execution variability
formula: Group passed/failed attempts by exact Test Case revision, build, environment, configuration and data hash. Failure rate is failed ÷ comparable attempts with a Wilson 95% interval; mixed outcomes are suspect and groups below five observations without mixed outcomes are insufficient samples.
criteria: Disclose sample size, comparison key, excluded incomparable attempts and dependence assumptions. Mixed outcomes are evidence for investigation, not confirmed flakiness or permission to quarantine. Do not invent calibrated failure probabilities.

label: Verified release gates
formula: Exact-scope, source-completeness, critical-Defect, execution, obligation-coverage and approved-policy gates produce ready, not_ready or unknown. Any failed gate blocks readiness; unknown evidence remains unknown. Approved waivers and organization policy are separate authority records.
criteria: Explain each gate using its recorded evidence, scope and authorized policy. Do not replace a gate with an average, infer a waiver, turn a hypothetical simulation into observed improvement or authorize deployment.

label: Quality graph evidence completeness
surface: AI Quality Graph and impact traversal
formula: Graph nodes and recorded/reviewed edges retain source revisions. Traversal is incomplete when sources are partial, roots are missing or depth/node bounds omit reachable evidence. There is no graph accuracy percentage.
criteria: Report known nodes, relationships, missing roots and explicit traversal limits. Recorded links prove traceability, not causal impact, assertion adequacy or execution. Never invent edges or a completeness score from loaded node counts.

label: Dashboard Story risk heuristic
formula: 50 points for no scoped linked Test Cases + 20 for P1/P2 priority + 15 per failed or blocked latest result + 10 per distinct open linked Defect. High starts at 50, medium at 20. The raw additive score is not bounded to a percentage.
criteria: Use this for relative review ordering only. Disclose exact signals and scoped counts; do not label the raw score as a probability or a percentage or confuse it with release Story risk.

label: Draft contract completeness
surface: AI Story and Test Case draft review
formula: Local checks report missing or invalid native draft fields, priorities, actions, expected results, parameter references and permitted Story links. No model-confidence or semantic-coverage percentage is calculated.
criteria: Identify the exact missing native contract field and smallest correction. A structurally complete draft still requires semantic review; do not treat it as approved, executed or evidence of full coverage.

label: Legacy response confidence fields
surface: Change-impact, rich-text and dashboard compatibility responses
formula: Historical response fields include fixed values such as 0.82/0.58 for linked impact evidence, 0.74/1 for rich-text generation/fallback and 0.78/0.74 for dashboard layout templates/model output. These are compatibility values; no model accuracy or certainty is measured.
criteria: Do not display or interpret compatibility confidence constants as probabilities, quality scores or verified evidence. Prefer explicit source refs, source completeness, native validation, generation mode and human review. These constants are not tunable business formulas.

label: Dashboard automation classification
formula: Cases explicitly marked automated yes or automation_status ready ÷ all scoped Test Cases × 100; an empty denominator yields 0%.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Development Story completion
formula: Stories in Dev Done, QA Ready, QA In Progress, QA Blocked, QA Done or a completed status ÷ all scoped Stories × 100. Each Story counts once; an empty denominator yields 0%.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: QA Story completion
formula: Stories in QA Done or a completed status ÷ all scoped Stories × 100. Dev Done alone does not count; an empty denominator yields 0%.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Stories with all tests passed
formula: Stories with at least one scoped linked Test Case and every linked case latest result passed ÷ all scoped Stories × 100. An empty denominator yields 0%.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Stories with all tests finalized
formula: Stories with at least one scoped linked Test Case and every linked case latest result passed, failed, blocked, skipped, aborted or cancelled ÷ all scoped Stories × 100. An empty denominator yields 0%.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Dashboard Defect traceability
formula: Distinct scoped Defects linked to a scoped Story, Test Case or run ÷ all scoped Defects × 100. No Defects yields 100% because no traceability gap is present.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Scoped native record counts
formula: Count distinct native records for the selected metric: count counts scoped Defects; stories, testCases, testSuites and testRuns count their respective records; moduleCaseCount counts scoped cases with at least one module; linkedDefects counts scoped Defects with a current Story, case or run relation. Relationship multiplicity never increases record counts.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Story and module relationship counts
formula: linkedTestCases counts distinct cases linked to a scoped Story; unlinkedTestCases counts cases with no valid project Story link; unassignedModuleCases counts cases without an explicit or inherited module. Foreign and deleted links do not establish coverage.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Scoped evidence attention counts
formula: coverageGaps counts Stories without scoped cases; openDefects counts distinct unresolved Defects; failedRuns counts runs in failed state; failedCases and blockedCases count distinct cases whose latest result has that status; unexecutedCases counts cases without a saved result; storiesWithOpenDefects counts distinct Stories linked directly or through cases to an unresolved Defect.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Completed runs in 30 days
formula: Runs in passed, completed, failed, blocked, skipped, aborted, cancelled or partially_completed state whose valid ended_at is within the last 30 days and not in the future.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Average project outcome rate
formula: Arithmetic mean of the combined finalized-Test-Case/resolved-Defect pass rate for accessible assessed projects with an outcome denominator. This is a descriptive observed-outcome rate, not a calibrated confidence probability.
criteria: Use the exact authorized project and planning scope, distinct native entity IDs, documented statuses and complete evidence denominators. Explain numerator, denominator, missing evidence and scope. Do not infer approval, semantic coverage, product correctness or a predictive probability from a count or percentage.

label: Model transport observability
formula: Recorded model calls, successful transport responses, failed/invalid responses, corrections, MCP context gaps, unmapped configuration, average/p95 request latency, reported total tokens, reported cached input tokens, unknown total/cache usage and failed trace writes. Retention and scope filters apply. No semantic-quality score, unreported cache-token count or token price is inferred.
criteria: Read these as transport and contract-validation evidence. A successful provider response is not factual correctness, coverage completeness or release readiness. Unknown token usage remains unknown; agents/native tasks retain Agent Studio trace ownership.
runtime_note: Operational observations are displayed in AI Controls Metrics and Agent Studio traces. Counters are measured by the application and have no tunable business formula.

label: Knowledge retrieval ranking
formula: Keyword mode ranks normalized lexical matches; semantic mode ranks compatible-vector cosine similarity. Hybrid retrieval uses normalized reciprocal-rank fusion × 45% + semantic score × 31% + lexical score × 24%, capped at one. Query fusion applies its separately disclosed best-score and reciprocal-rank signals.
criteria: Ranking scores order permitted evidence candidates; they are not calibrated factual correctness or confidence probabilities. Preserve source identity, source version, query/mode and exact authorization scope. A high rank does not establish support for a proposed claim.

label: Knowledge evidence sufficiency
formula: Citation-ready hits contribute up to 24 points, source diversity 24, strongest indexed retrieval score 20, multi-query corroboration 12, live evidence 6, route alignment 8 and topical matches 6; total capped at 100. Strong starts at 65, usable at 45; below 65 requests more context.
criteria: Explain which source, citation, topical-match and diversity signals are present. This is a retrieval heuristic, not proof of answer completeness or claim entailment. Do not turn missing context into invented facts or a definitive verdict.

label: Indexed document context quality
formula: Start at 100 and subtract bounded duplicate-chunk, undersized-chunk, missing-heading, excessive-overlap, low-content-bearing and low-lexical-diversity penalties. Empty extracted text or no nonempty chunk produces zero. Grades: excellent ≥90, good ≥75, review ≥55, otherwise poor; below 75 requires review. Heading/lineage coverage, overlap and lexical diversity are separate ratios.
criteria: Treat the score as structural extraction/indexing quality. It does not measure factual currency, semantic completeness or source authority. Inspect duplication, headings, chunk lineage, content-bearing ratios and redactions independently; missing extraction cannot be excellent.

label: Knowledge retrieval fixture evaluation
formula: For each deterministic fixture, calculate recall@k, precision@k, reciprocal first-relevant rank, nDCG and hit status from expected versus selected evidence IDs, then average per request. Record unauthorized exposure counts and request exposure rate separately.
criteria: Report the exact fixture set, expected relevance judgments, limits and sample size. These deterministic fixtures do not establish production semantic recall, model injection resistance, calibrated confidence or noisy-neighbor isolation.
runtime_note: Evaluation observations are read-only. Change fixtures and execute the knowledge evaluation workflow to measure retrieval behavior; there is no editable runtime formula.

label: Knowledge claim support and rejection
formula: Claims must contain supported evidence IDs from the authorized context packet. Deterministic or verified-entailment claims are supported; exact extractive support is separate from citation-bound interpretation. Count rejected claims and invalid structured presentations; a bound citation alone does not verify entailment.
criteria: Preserve the difference between cited interpretation, exact extractive support and completed verification. Unsupported IDs, unresolved promises and malformed presentations never become verified claims. Report rejected claims and explicit limits; do not accept model confidence as evidence.
